How a recommendation in a guideline gets its evidence — who looks, where they
look, and what makes a source *authoritative* rather than merely cited.

**STRAWPERSON.** The process shape below renders and passes the workflow policy
gate. Not settled: which registries count as trusted, which grading system a
folio declares, and how the observatory APIs are bound.

## Why this is a subprocess of editing
{: #why-this-is-a-subprocess data-fa-label="sec:evidence-why-this-is-a-subprocess" }

[✎ Edit](https://github.com/litlfred/folio-assistant-core/edit/main/docs/source/process-evidence/why-this-is-a-subprocess.md){: .fa-node-edit title="Edit docs/source/process-evidence/why-this-is-a-subprocess.md" data-fa-link="edit" data-src="docs/source/process-evidence/why-this-is-a-subprocess.md" data-repo="litlfred/folio-assistant-core" } <span class="fa-qa-badges"><button type="button" class="fa-qa-badge fa-qa-pending fa-qa-fam-block" lang="en" dir="ltr" data-qa-family="block" data-qa-key="why-this-is-a-subprocess.block" data-qa-label="Content QA" data-qa-noun="block" data-qa-src="{{ '/assets/qa/folio-assistant-core/process-evidence/why-this-is-a-subprocess.block.json' | relative_url }}" data-qa-index="{{ '/assets/qa/folio-assistant-core/process-evidence/qa-index.json' | relative_url }}" aria-expanded="false" aria-busy="true" title="Content QA: loading the verdict…" aria-label="Content QA: loading the verdict…"><span class="fa-qa-tag">QA</span><span class="fa-qa-glyph" aria-hidden="true">…</span></button> <button type="button" class="fa-qa-badge fa-qa-pending fa-qa-fam-translation" lang="en" dir="ltr" data-qa-family="translation" data-qa-key="why-this-is-a-subprocess.translation" data-qa-label="Translation QA" data-qa-noun="block" data-qa-src="{{ '/assets/qa/folio-assistant-core/process-evidence/why-this-is-a-subprocess.translation.json' | relative_url }}" data-qa-index="{{ '/assets/qa/folio-assistant-core/process-evidence/qa-index.json' | relative_url }}" aria-expanded="false" aria-busy="true" title="Translation QA: loading the verdict…" aria-label="Translation QA: loading the verdict…"><span class="fa-qa-tag">TR</span><span class="fa-qa-glyph" aria-hidden="true">…</span></button></span>

It runs inside the editing loop, between claiming the bean and drafting the
change — see [Editing and the HCI validation
gate](publication-workflow.html#editing-and-the-hci-validation-gate). **The
evidence is gathered before the sentence is written, not assembled afterwards
to support one.**

It is a *call activity*, with its own file, lanes and diagram, so the editing
diagram stays readable. Content that carries no recommendations — a
mathematics folio — skips it rather than satisfying it vacuously.

## The subprocess
{: #the-subprocess data-fa-label="sec:evidence-the-subprocess" }

[✎ Edit](https://github.com/litlfred/folio-assistant-core/edit/main/processes/content/evidence-retrieval.bpmn){: .fa-node-edit title="Edit processes/content/evidence-retrieval.bpmn" data-fa-link="edit" data-src="processes/content/evidence-retrieval.bpmn" data-repo="litlfred/folio-assistant-core" } <span class="fa-qa-badges"><button type="button" class="fa-qa-badge fa-qa-pending fa-qa-fam-kg" lang="en" dir="ltr" data-qa-family="kg" data-qa-key="the-subprocess.kg" data-qa-label="Knowledge-graph QA" data-qa-noun="diagram" data-qa-src="{{ '/assets/qa/folio-assistant-core/process-evidence/the-subprocess.kg.json' | relative_url }}" data-qa-index="{{ '/assets/qa/folio-assistant-core/process-evidence/qa-index.json' | relative_url }}" aria-expanded="false" aria-busy="true" title="Knowledge-graph QA: loading the verdict…" aria-label="Knowledge-graph QA: loading the verdict…"><span class="fa-qa-tag">KG</span><span class="fa-qa-glyph" aria-hidden="true">…</span></button></span>

Four lanes, one per kind of actor:

| lane | who | owns |
|---|---|---|
| Author / guideline developer | person | the PICO, the appraisal, the grade |
| Evidence agent | system | retrieval across the three classes |
| Trusted registries and observatories | **external** | whether a citation resolves |
| Work plan — beans | shared | every gap and every unverified citation |

The registries lane is external because **authority is not something the folio
can assert about itself**: it is resolved at the publisher.

<div class="bpmn-figure" id="figure-the-subprocess">
  <img src="{{ '/assets/img/workflows/evidence-retrieval.svg' | relative_url }}"
       alt="BPMN swimlane diagram across four lanes. The author reviews the guidance already in their content, then frames the question as PICO. A parallel gateway fans out to three retrieval tasks run by the evidence agent: trusted L1 sources under library/, trusted L2 DAK and L3 IG content, and data repositories and statistical datasets. The candidates join, and the trusted-registries lane verifies each one's authority against the publishing body's API; an exclusive gateway routes an unconfirmed citation to a bean on the work plan before rejoining. The author then appraises and grades the body of evidence, and a second exclusive gateway asks whether it is sufficient for a recommendation: if not, the gap is recorded as a bean and the process ends without one; if so, the evidence is attached to the recommendation.">
</div>

## Step one looks inward
{: #review-first data-fa-label="sec:evidence-review-first" }

[✎ Edit](https://github.com/litlfred/folio-assistant-core/edit/main/docs/source/process-evidence/review-first.md){: .fa-node-edit title="Edit docs/source/process-evidence/review-first.md" data-fa-link="edit" data-src="docs/source/process-evidence/review-first.md" data-repo="litlfred/folio-assistant-core" } <span class="fa-qa-badges"><button type="button" class="fa-qa-badge fa-qa-pending fa-qa-fam-block" lang="en" dir="ltr" data-qa-family="block" data-qa-key="review-first.block" data-qa-label="Content QA" data-qa-noun="block" data-qa-src="{{ '/assets/qa/folio-assistant-core/process-evidence/review-first.block.json' | relative_url }}" data-qa-index="{{ '/assets/qa/folio-assistant-core/process-evidence/qa-index.json' | relative_url }}" aria-expanded="false" aria-busy="true" title="Content QA: loading the verdict…" aria-label="Content QA: loading the verdict…"><span class="fa-qa-tag">QA</span><span class="fa-qa-glyph" aria-hidden="true">…</span></button> <button type="button" class="fa-qa-badge fa-qa-pending fa-qa-fam-translation" lang="en" dir="ltr" data-qa-family="translation" data-qa-key="review-first.translation" data-qa-label="Translation QA" data-qa-noun="block" data-qa-src="{{ '/assets/qa/folio-assistant-core/process-evidence/review-first.translation.json' | relative_url }}" data-qa-index="{{ '/assets/qa/folio-assistant-core/process-evidence/qa-index.json' | relative_url }}" aria-expanded="false" aria-busy="true" title="Translation QA: loading the verdict…" aria-label="Translation QA: loading the verdict…"><span class="fa-qa-tag">TR</span><span class="fa-qa-glyph" aria-hidden="true">…</span></button></span>

Before any search, the author reads what the document, DAK or IG *already* says
on this question. A new recommendation that contradicts a sibling
recommendation in the same artefact is a defect that no external evidence will
reveal.

## Framing the question as PICO
{: #pico data-fa-label="sec:evidence-pico" }

[✎ Edit](https://github.com/litlfred/folio-assistant-core/edit/main/docs/source/process-evidence/pico.md){: .fa-node-edit title="Edit docs/source/process-evidence/pico.md" data-fa-link="edit" data-src="docs/source/process-evidence/pico.md" data-repo="litlfred/folio-assistant-core" } <span class="fa-qa-badges"><button type="button" class="fa-qa-badge fa-qa-pending fa-qa-fam-block" lang="en" dir="ltr" data-qa-family="block" data-qa-key="pico.block" data-qa-label="Content QA" data-qa-noun="block" data-qa-src="{{ '/assets/qa/folio-assistant-core/process-evidence/pico.block.json' | relative_url }}" data-qa-index="{{ '/assets/qa/folio-assistant-core/process-evidence/qa-index.json' | relative_url }}" aria-expanded="false" aria-busy="true" title="Content QA: loading the verdict…" aria-label="Content QA: loading the verdict…"><span class="fa-qa-tag">QA</span><span class="fa-qa-glyph" aria-hidden="true">…</span></button> <button type="button" class="fa-qa-badge fa-qa-pending fa-qa-fam-translation" lang="en" dir="ltr" data-qa-family="translation" data-qa-key="pico.translation" data-qa-label="Translation QA" data-qa-noun="block" data-qa-src="{{ '/assets/qa/folio-assistant-core/process-evidence/pico.translation.json' | relative_url }}" data-qa-index="{{ '/assets/qa/folio-assistant-core/process-evidence/qa-index.json' | relative_url }}" aria-expanded="false" aria-busy="true" title="Translation QA: loading the verdict…" aria-label="Translation QA: loading the verdict…"><span class="fa-qa-tag">TR</span><span class="fa-qa-glyph" aria-hidden="true">…</span></button></span>

**Population, Intervention, Comparator, Outcome.**

WHO guideline development states the question this way before any retrieval.
With a PICO the search is reproducible: a second reader can run it and say
whether the same body of evidence comes back.

The PICO is carried on the recommendation, not discarded after the search, so a
later reader can tell whether new evidence bears on this recommendation or a
different one.

## Three classes of evidence, not one
{: #three-classes data-fa-label="sec:evidence-three-classes" }

[✎ Edit](https://github.com/litlfred/folio-assistant-core/edit/main/docs/source/process-evidence/three-classes.md){: .fa-node-edit title="Edit docs/source/process-evidence/three-classes.md" data-fa-link="edit" data-src="docs/source/process-evidence/three-classes.md" data-repo="litlfred/folio-assistant-core" } <span class="fa-qa-badges"><button type="button" class="fa-qa-badge fa-qa-pending fa-qa-fam-block" lang="en" dir="ltr" data-qa-family="block" data-qa-key="three-classes.block" data-qa-label="Content QA" data-qa-noun="block" data-qa-src="{{ '/assets/qa/folio-assistant-core/process-evidence/three-classes.block.json' | relative_url }}" data-qa-index="{{ '/assets/qa/folio-assistant-core/process-evidence/qa-index.json' | relative_url }}" aria-expanded="false" aria-busy="true" title="Content QA: loading the verdict…" aria-label="Content QA: loading the verdict…"><span class="fa-qa-tag">QA</span><span class="fa-qa-glyph" aria-hidden="true">…</span></button> <button type="button" class="fa-qa-badge fa-qa-pending fa-qa-fam-translation" lang="en" dir="ltr" data-qa-family="translation" data-qa-key="three-classes.translation" data-qa-label="Translation QA" data-qa-noun="block" data-qa-src="{{ '/assets/qa/folio-assistant-core/process-evidence/three-classes.translation.json' | relative_url }}" data-qa-index="{{ '/assets/qa/folio-assistant-core/process-evidence/qa-index.json' | relative_url }}" aria-expanded="false" aria-busy="true" title="Translation QA: loading the verdict…" aria-label="Translation QA: loading the verdict…"><span class="fa-qa-tag">TR</span><span class="fa-qa-glyph" aria-hidden="true">…</span></button></span>

Retrieval fans out across **three classes that are not interchangeable**, kept
apart by the parallel gateway:

**Trusted sources — L1.** Ingested primary literature under `library/`: the
`sections/*.md` tree and, where a document was scanned, `ocr/page-NNN.txt`.

> **Known blind spot.** A document that was OCR'd but never re-run through
> `pdf-structure.py` has only a stub in `sections/`, so a sections-only search
> misses it. See [Document ingestion](../guides/document-ingestion.html).

**Trusted content — L2 DAKs, L3 IGs.** Already-adjudicated guidance: WHO SMART
Digital Adaptation Kits at L2, FHIR Implementation Guides at L3. A
recommendation adopted in a published DAK is a *prior decision*, with its own
provenance and grading, and is cited as that — never as primary evidence.

**Data repositories and statistical datasets.** Indicator series and microdata.
The unit of evidence is a **measurement** with a population, a period and a
method attached — not a claim in prose.

## Verifying authority, not asserting it
{: #authority data-fa-label="sec:evidence-authority" }

[✎ Edit](https://github.com/litlfred/folio-assistant-core/edit/main/docs/source/process-evidence/authority.md){: .fa-node-edit title="Edit docs/source/process-evidence/authority.md" data-fa-link="edit" data-src="docs/source/process-evidence/authority.md" data-repo="litlfred/folio-assistant-core" } <span class="fa-qa-badges"><button type="button" class="fa-qa-badge fa-qa-pending fa-qa-fam-block" lang="en" dir="ltr" data-qa-family="block" data-qa-key="authority.block" data-qa-label="Content QA" data-qa-noun="block" data-qa-src="{{ '/assets/qa/folio-assistant-core/process-evidence/authority.block.json' | relative_url }}" data-qa-index="{{ '/assets/qa/folio-assistant-core/process-evidence/qa-index.json' | relative_url }}" aria-expanded="false" aria-busy="true" title="Content QA: loading the verdict…" aria-label="Content QA: loading the verdict…"><span class="fa-qa-tag">QA</span><span class="fa-qa-glyph" aria-hidden="true">…</span></button> <button type="button" class="fa-qa-badge fa-qa-pending fa-qa-fam-translation" lang="en" dir="ltr" data-qa-family="translation" data-qa-key="authority.translation" data-qa-label="Translation QA" data-qa-noun="block" data-qa-src="{{ '/assets/qa/folio-assistant-core/process-evidence/authority.translation.json' | relative_url }}" data-qa-index="{{ '/assets/qa/folio-assistant-core/process-evidence/qa-index.json' | relative_url }}" aria-expanded="false" aria-busy="true" title="Translation QA: loading the verdict…" aria-label="Translation QA: loading the verdict…"><span class="fa-qa-tag">TR</span><span class="fa-qa-glyph" aria-hidden="true">…</span></button></span>

Each candidate is resolved against the **standard API of the body that publishes
it**, so that "authoritative" is a resolved fact rather than an assertion in a
citation. Four things are checked:

1. the identifier **resolves** at the publisher;
2. the retrieved record **matches what the citation claims**;
3. the **version and date** are the ones cited;
4. the publisher is one this folio has **declared trusted**.

Check 2 catches the real errors: a citation can resolve and still not say what
the sentence citing it says.

**An unresolvable citation is neither dropped nor silently kept.** It becomes a
bean, so the gap is visible in the work plan.

> **Not settled:** the registry list, the endpoints, and the shape of the
> stored authority record. No endpoint below "the publisher's own API" has been
> verified, so none is named.

## Grading the body, and recording a gap
{: #grading-and-gaps data-fa-label="sec:evidence-grading-and-gaps" }

[✎ Edit](https://github.com/litlfred/folio-assistant-core/edit/main/docs/source/process-evidence/grading-and-gaps.md){: .fa-node-edit title="Edit docs/source/process-evidence/grading-and-gaps.md" data-fa-link="edit" data-src="docs/source/process-evidence/grading-and-gaps.md" data-repo="litlfred/folio-assistant-core" } <span class="fa-qa-badges"><button type="button" class="fa-qa-badge fa-qa-pending fa-qa-fam-block" lang="en" dir="ltr" data-qa-family="block" data-qa-key="grading-and-gaps.block" data-qa-label="Content QA" data-qa-noun="block" data-qa-src="{{ '/assets/qa/folio-assistant-core/process-evidence/grading-and-gaps.block.json' | relative_url }}" data-qa-index="{{ '/assets/qa/folio-assistant-core/process-evidence/qa-index.json' | relative_url }}" aria-expanded="false" aria-busy="true" title="Content QA: loading the verdict…" aria-label="Content QA: loading the verdict…"><span class="fa-qa-tag">QA</span><span class="fa-qa-glyph" aria-hidden="true">…</span></button> <button type="button" class="fa-qa-badge fa-qa-pending fa-qa-fam-translation" lang="en" dir="ltr" data-qa-family="translation" data-qa-key="grading-and-gaps.translation" data-qa-label="Translation QA" data-qa-noun="block" data-qa-src="{{ '/assets/qa/folio-assistant-core/process-evidence/grading-and-gaps.translation.json' | relative_url }}" data-qa-index="{{ '/assets/qa/folio-assistant-core/process-evidence/qa-index.json' | relative_url }}" aria-expanded="false" aria-busy="true" title="Translation QA: loading the verdict…" aria-label="Translation QA: loading the verdict…"><span class="fa-qa-tag">TR</span><span class="fa-qa-glyph" aria-hidden="true">…</span></button></span>

The grade attaches to the **body** of evidence for one PICO question, so
appraisal sits after the join, not inside the fan-out. A single citation does
not carry a certainty rating.

Then one gateway: **is this sufficient for a recommendation?**

**Insufficient evidence is a result.** It is recorded as a gap the guideline
can state — *"the evidence does not support a recommendation here"* — never
closed by weakening the recommendation until the evidence supports it.

On the "yes" branch the PICO, the graded body of evidence, and every verified
citation with its resolved authority record are written onto the
recommendation block, so a reader can retrace the chain from the sentence to
the source.
